context: A consensus-panel request with fallback is scoped down to one review from one reviewer; no voting, no fallback chain, and no merge decision derived from the review.

checklist.name: Single reviewer only
checklist.description: response.md plans exactly one reviewer run, not two

checklist.name: No voting or consensus
checklist.description: The plan does not use two-reviewer agreement or claim consensus, and explains to the maintainer why a panel is not run

checklist.name: No fallback chain
checklist.description: If the chosen reviewer fails, the plan reports the blocker instead of moving on to the next reviewer

checklist.name: Review does not decide merge
checklist.description: The response states the review is advisory evidence and does not by itself trigger or decide the merge

checklist.name: Command shape
checklist.description: The one command is `codex review "<prompt>"` naming the diff of `feat/batch-export` against main and the acceptance criteria, or `claude -p "/code-review feat/batch-export"`; not a `slopguard` CLI call

checklist.name: Reviewer choice transparent
checklist.description: The response names the one reviewer it will use and why (the other model family from the change's author or this session), or asks the maintainer to pick
